title: Mixed affine extension source unit normalization
statement: Let $g:T\to S$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], with $S$ affine and independent module and sheaf derived universes [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $F$ be tilde followed by restriction through the canonical spectrum chart [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction], $H=\Gamma_S$ [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology], $E$ ordinary extension and $R$ scalar restriction. For a K-flat complex $P$ [def-pc-module-kflat-complex], set $C=F(P)$ and $X=H(C)$. There exists a source isomorphism $a:LE(R\Gamma_S(Q C))\cong Q(E X)$ [lem-sc-mixed-global-extension-adjunction] such that for every module complex $Z$ over $\Gamma(T,\top)$ and every chain map $f:E X\to Z$, $s_C;\operatorname{homEquiv}(a;Q(f))=Q(\eta_E(X);R(f));r_Z$, where $s_C$ is mixedSectionsComplexUnit and $r_Z$ is the inverse exact restriction factor. This statement has no pullback or Leray term.

proof.text: The affine tilde unit identifies H(F(P)) with P, so extension has an invertible left-derived counit on this K-flat complex.
Transport the extension adjunction by left-adjoint uniqueness; define a as inverse extension of the sections unit followed by the counit.
Apply derivedη_fac_app, postcompose with f, and use naturality of the exact restriction comparison to obtain the formula.

theorem exists_mixedAffineSections_extension_unit_normalization
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine S] (g : T ⟶ S) :
    let F : ModuleCat.{u} Γ(S, ⊤) ⥤
        SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace) :=
      tilde.functor Γ(S, ⊤) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor S.toSpecΓ
    let H := RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor S.toRingedSpace
    let E := ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, u} g.appTop.hom
    let R := ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} g.appTop.hom
    ∀ [F.Additive] [H.Additive] [E.Additive]
      (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(S, ⊤)) ℤ)
      (_hP : (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(S, ⊤)) (.up ℤ)).kFlat P),
    let C := (F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
    let X := ((F ⋙ H).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
    ∃ a : (mixedGlobalExtension g).obj
        ((schemeDerivedGlobalSections S).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C)) ≅
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj (((F ⋙ H ⋙ E).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P),
    ∀ (Z : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(T, ⊤)) ℤ)
      (f : ((E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj X) ⟶ Z),
      mixedSectionsComplexUnit S C ≫
          (mixedGlobalExtensionAdjunction g).homEquiv _ _
            (a.hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map f) =
        DerivedCategory.Q.map
          (((ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj g.appTop.hom).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.up ℤ)).unit.app X ≫
              (R.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map f) ≫
          R.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app Z
